content.short: Fordefi's MPC wallet provides cross-chain connectivity, policy controls, and risk alerts.
content.description: Fordefi's MPC wallet and security platform delivers native connectivity to dozens of blockchains, supported by self-serve policy controls, smart contract address verification, and transaction simulation. It also includes real-time risk alerts and a full-stack developer suite of native APIs and SDKs, empowering institutions to connect to dApps across chains while maintaining secure custody of digital assets across multi-chain environments.
content.meta: Fordefi is an MPC wallet and security platform with cross-chain connectivity and risk alerts. Discover Fordefi and other Web3 Wallets on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
